diagnosis.measured: Same-session capture passes with and without clip. Separate-session capture without clip preserves screen checks but fails DPR image bounds. Separate-session clipped capture immediately changes all six document screens on that same page. Original mixed-client failures are retained.
diagnosis.source_inference: PageHandler capture consults its own EmulationHandler parameters and applies temporary/restored state. The capture session differs from the metrics owner; this is consistent with the measured same-target cross-session failure, not proof of cross-page leakage.
diagnosis.next_gate: Use the retained exact-version stock/Glint controls to design and validate ownership-safe screenshot state restoration, including concurrent changes and navigation, without weakening screen or PNG/DPR assertions.
